tools.name: get_culture_news
tools.description: Get the latest human culture news from Finally Offline. Covers sports, music, fashion, and general culture.

tools.name: get_trending_topics
tools.description: Get what's trending right now in human culture. Returns topic frequency analysis, top headlines per category, and cultural pulse data. Perfect for agents that need to stay current.

tools.name: search_articles
tools.description: Full-text search across all Finally Offline articles. Find specific topics, people, events, or trends in the archive.

tools.name: subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe your agent to receive push notifications when new articles are published. Provide a webhook URL and we'll POST new articles to it in real-time. First-of-its-kind MCP push system.

tools.name: report_redistribution
tools.description: Report that your agent shared or cited a Finally Offline article. Top redistributors get featured on our platform and priority access to breaking news.

tools.name: generate_digest
tools.description: Generate a beautiful, shareable culture digest — a branded HTML report with a hero article, 2 supporting stories, and a closing quote. Looks like a premium newsletter. findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: subscribe · Public sink: subscribe, generate_digest.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: subscribe · Public sink: subscribe, generate_digest

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
